title: SSC CPO Paper-1 Full Length Mock Test 03 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CPO SI Paper-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: General Intelligence & Reasoning 25, General Knowledge & GA 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English Comprehension 25.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC CPO SI Paper-1 latest pattern ke anusar (condensed 100Q mock).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 10, 29, 66, 127, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: 7, 19, 37, 61. Second differences: 12, 18, 24 (increase by 6), so next second difference is 30. Next first difference = 61+30=91. Therefore 127+91=218.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not leap from Aug 2024 to Aug 2025 includes Feb 29? 2024 is leap but Feb already passed after Aug 2024. From 15 Aug 2024 to 15 Aug 2025 = 365 days = 1 odd day → Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock at right angle for the first time?
questions.explanation: Right angle times: M=(2/11)(30H±90). For H=3 first value is (2/11)(90-90)=0 (at 3:00 they are not at 90). Valid first is (2/11)(90+90)? Standard first between 3-4 is 16 4/11 min: (2/11)×(90) = 180/11 = 16 4/11.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P,Q,R,S,T sit in a row facing north. Q is second to the right of P. S is at one end. R is immediate left of T. P is not next to S. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: S at end. Possible: S _ _ _ _ or _ _ _ _ S. Q is 2nd right of P so P _ Q. R immediate left of T → RT. P not next to S. Arrangement: S P R Q T? Q is 2nd right of P only if P R Q. Middle is Q if S P R Q T — P next to S, invalid. P R Q T S: Q 2nd right of P yes, S at end, R left of T, P not next to S. Middle is Q.
